title: Add workspace panes
description: Register pane content that uses Zync's normal split and docking system.

title: Add dashboard cards
description: Register isolated cards on supported Zync dashboards.

title: Add commands
description: Register commands in approved Zync command surfaces.

title: Add status items
description: Display bounded text, icons, and actions in status areas.

title: Show notifications
description: Show notifications identified as coming from this plugin.

title: Add sidebar entries
description: Register navigation entries that open this plugin's surfaces.

title: Add plugin settings
description: Register settings owned and namespaced by this plugin.

title: Add file editors
description: Register isolated viewers or editors for supported file types.

title: Add appearance resources
description: Provide validated theme tokens or icon assets without host CSS.

title: Read connection details
description: Read non-secret metadata for connections the user approves.

title: Send terminal input
description: Send approved text to terminals in the granted connection scope.

title: Create terminal tabs
description: Open terminals in connections the user approves.

title: Run terminal commands
description: Execute approved commands in the granted terminal scope.

title: Run SSH commands
description: Run arbitrary commands with your SSH account's authority on servers where you open this plugin. Commands can read, change, or delete server data.

title: Read plugin data
description: Read files from this plugin's private data directory.

title: Write plugin data
description: Write files inside this plugin's private data directory.

title: Read selected files
description: Read files or folders the user explicitly selects.

title: Change selected files
description: Create or modify files in locations the user explicitly selects.

title: Read files on pane servers
description: Read files and folders on the SSH server attached to a plugin pane.

title: Connect to approved websites
description: Make brokered network requests to the domains shown during approval.

title: Connect to local services
description: Connect to explicitly approved loopback or private-network services.

title: Show confirmation dialogs
description: Ask for confirmation in clearly identified Zync-owned dialogs.

title: Read clipboard text
description: Read clipboard text after a foreground user action.

title: Write clipboard text
description: Replace clipboard text after a foreground user action.

title: Read plugin inventory
description: Read non-secret metadata about installed plugins.
